definitions.gloss: fertile; rich; productive (of land or soil)
definitions.explanation: Describes land or soil that is rich in nutrients and capable of producing abundant crops or vegetation.

examples.japanese: {肥沃|ひよく}な⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肥沃|ひよく}な⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれている→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧。
examples.english: This region is blessed with fertile soil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肥沃|ひよく}な⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つくり、⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だった。
examples.english: River flooding created fertile land, and agriculture has thrived since ancient times.

notes:
Na-adjective: ⟦{肥沃|ひよく}→肥沃：20227_hiyoku⟧ ({肥|ひ} = fertile, fat + {沃|よく} = irrigate, enrich). A somewhat literary or formal word typically used in written contexts about geography, agriculture, or history.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {肥沃|ひよく}に (rare)
- Noun form: ⟦{肥沃|ひよく}→肥沃：20227_hiyoku⟧さ (fertility of land)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肥沃|ひよく}な⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧ (fertile land)
- {肥沃|ひよく}な⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧ (fertile soil)
- {肥沃|ひよく}な⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧ (fertile earth)

The opposite is ⟦{不毛|ふもう}→不毛：11316_fumou⟧ (barren, infertile).
